title: ESTIMATE FWHM SMOOTHNESS OF A METRIC FILE
description: Estimates the smoothness of the metric columns, printing the estimates to standard output.  These estimates ignore variation in vertex spacing.

surface.description: the surface to use for distance and neighbor information

roi.description: use only data within an ROI

column.description: select a single column to estimate smoothness of

demean.description: subtract the mean image before estimating smoothness

whole_file.description: estimate for the whole file at once, not each column separately
